evals.name: review-only-novel
evals.prompt: 帮我检查一下这本英文小说 Harbour_Lights.indd 的排版，要印刷成书。先只检查，不要改文件。InDesign 的检查结果和几段文字在附件里：evals/files/review/inspection.json 和 evals/files/review/excerpts.md。
evals.expected_output: A Chinese-language review report only (no edits). Asks the academic-vs-aesthetic purpose question rather than inferring it from 'novel'. Flags: chapter Three starting on a left page (physical 10, LEFT_HAND) and Two on physical 8 LEFT_HAND in a facing-page print book; single Arabic section with manually typed roman folios (iii/iv frames); overset story 415 on physical page 9; accidental leading spaces (Excerpt A); straight quotes used as quotation marks (Excerpt B/D) while preserving 5'11" as a measurement; the runt 'sea.' (Excerpt B); the per-line paragraph marks in Excerpt C (5 marks, a clear pattern) as a repair candidate; notes LINK_EMBEDDED is not missing. Records locations. Does not claim widow/runt absence from inspection alone.
assertions: Reply to the user is in Chinese
Makes no document edits and does not claim any (review only)
Asks whether this is academic final typesetting or an aesthetically focused layout instead of inferring it from 'novel'
Flags the single Arabic section with manually typed roman folios (iii, iv) as a section-numbering problem
Flags overset text in story 415 on page 9
Flags the accidental leading spaces at the start of the Foreword paragraph (Excerpt A)
Flags straight quotes used as quotation marks AND treats 5'11" as a measurement to preserve
Flags the one-word final line 'sea.' as a runt (Excerpt B)

Identifies the per-line paragraph marks in Excerpt C as PDF-paste breaks, states how many it counts as erroneous, and applies the matching rule (1-3: ask first; 4+ clear pattern: repair within scope) consistently with that count
Addresses the chapter openings on left-hand pages (Two at physical 8, Three at physical 10) or explicitly raises the right-page-start convention decision for this novel
Does not report the LINK_EMBEDDED image as missing
Does not claim the whole book is free of widows/orphans/rivers/runts; states the review's scope limits

evals.name: mcp-runt-tracking-no-save
evals.prompt: InDesign MCP 已经连好了（indesign_local）。我的论文 Thesis_Final.indd 印刷页码第 23 页，第二段最后一行只剩一个单词 results.，帮我用字距收一下。改完先别保存，我要自己看。模拟的工具返回结果在 evals/files/mcp/simulated-tool-results.md。
evals.expected_output: A step-by-step tool-call log with exact arguments, then a Chinese reply. Starts with get_connection_status, list_documents, and picks document id 3 'Thesis_Final.indd' (not the modified copy id 5), confirming identity. Maps printed folio 23 to physical page 37 for list_text_frames. Uses prepare_tracking_edit on a bounded range (<=128 chars) of the last line(s) with exact expected_text and a small negative tracking value, then apply_prepared_edit, then re-inspects composition/neighbours. Does not call save_document. Mentions restore_edit/transaction tx-91 is conditional restoration, not native Undo.
assertions: Calls get_connection_status and list_documents before any edit
Targets document id 3 'Thesis_Final.indd' (not the modified copy id 5) with matching expected_name
Uses physical_page=37 for printed folio 23
prepare_tracking_edit targets story 88 with length <= 128 characters inside the paragraph's last lines and supplies expected_text
Tracking value is a small adjustment (absolute value 1-30, tightening or loosening), not an extreme value
Calls apply_prepared_edit with the prepared plan_id only after prepare_tracking_edit
Checks the recomposed result after applying (runt gone, neighbouring lines/page 38 unchanged)
Does not call save_document and tells the user the change is unsaved
Reply to the user is in Chinese
Does not describe restore_edit as native InDesign Undo

evals.name: jsx-fallback-recto-check
evals.prompt: 我没装那个 InDesign MCP，也不想现在装。Mac 上的 InDesign 2026 已经打开了 Atlas.indd（已保存，路径是 evals/files/jsx/Atlas.indd）。这本书要印刷，双页对开，学术类。帮我检查每章第一页是不是都在右页。
evals.expected_output: Uses the JSX route: runs scripts/prepare_indesign_job.py with scripts/inspect_document.jsx and the document path, job root under a project work directory; shows the osascript/AppleScript (do script ... language javascript) or Scripts-panel route with the generated run.jsx/launcher path but does not execute it in this dry run; does not run setup.py or try to install MCP. After reading the simulated COMPLETE result, reports chapter 3 (physical 40, label 32) on LEFT_HAND as the violation, judged by page.side not page number; chapters 1, 2, 4 pass. Proposes inserting a blank left-hand page before chapter 3 but does not change the document (only a check was requested) and notes subsequent starts/pagination/TOC need rechecking after any insertion.
assertions: Runs scripts/prepare_indesign_job.py with scripts/inspect_document.jsx and the Atlas.indd path, job root under outputs/work
Does not execute osascript/AppleScript or install into the Scripts panel (marks them NOT RUN)
Does not run setup.py or attempt to install/configure MCP
Reads the job status/result before reporting the check outcome
Identifies Chapter 3 (physical 40, label 32) as starting on a left-hand page
Reports Chapters 1, 2 and 4 as starting on right-hand pages
Judges right/left by page side, explicitly not by page-number parity
Also checks the title page, contents and foreword starts
Proposes inserting a blank left-hand page before Chapter 3 but makes no document change
Notes that after an insertion later starts, pagination/sections and the table of contents must be rechecked
Reply to the user is in Chinese
